headline: Dentons Link Legal, Luthra act on Iris Global ₹200 crore+ proposed IPO
sum: Iris Global Services Limited has filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI and the Stock Exchanges with relation to an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to ₹200 crore and an offer for…
detail: Iris Global Services Limited has filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI and the Stock Exchanges with relation to an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to ₹200 crore and an offer for sale of up to 50,000,000 equity shares. Dentons Link Legal is advising Iris Global on this IPO, according to the DRHP. Luthra and Luthra Law Offices is advising Pantomath Capital Advisors Private Limited, the book running lead manager on this IPO. This transaction is being led by Kshitij Asthana (Managing Associate), with support from Associates Ashwin Singh, Harshit Babbar, Karan Kapoor, Kumar Anant Ashish, Manali Singh, Savar Arora, and Swetapadma…
